summary.en: Turkish troops remain in Syria and Iraq until border security is assured, while DNA testing has identified seven family members killed in Syria. Qatar has overhauled its entire defence system in six hours, according to its intelligence chief. Israel is supporting Druze forces against al-Sharaa and Iranian Kurdish separatists have been deported to Iraq, while armed groups used explosive-laden drones to target Syrian security posts in Suwayda. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tyrkiske tropper blir i Syria og Irak til grense­ sikkerheten er sikret, mens DNA-testing har identifisert syv familiemedlemmer som ble drept i Syria. Qatar har overhallet hele forsvarssystemet på seks timer, ifølge landets etterretningssjef. Israel støtter drusiske styrker mot al-Sharaa, og iranske kurdiske separatister er deportert til Irak, mens væpnede grupper brukte eksplosivbelastede droner mot syriske sikkerhetsposter i Suwayda. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
